fields.title: 📖 Allah’s Right Hand is full
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Allah’s Right Hand is full; no expenditure diminishes it. It gives abundantly by night and by day.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm what has come authentically concerning the **Ṣifāt of Allah**, without ***Takyīf***, without ***Tashbīh***, and without ***Taʿṭīl***. In this lies the refutation of the **Jahmiyyah**, who wanted to nullify such texts through denial and reinterpretation.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb at-Tawḥīd, Bāb: Qawl Allah taʿālā: limā khalaqtu bi-yadayya, Hadith Nr. 7411; auch bei Muslim Nr. 993.
